canonical_statement: For every real scalar distribution T on an open subset Omega of a finite-dimensional real normed space, the complement of the distributional support of T is the union of all open sets U on which T vanishes, meaning that T evaluates to zero on every test function whose topological support is contained in U.
domain_and_universes: universe u; E : Type u; NormedAddCommGroup E; NormedSpace Real E; FiniteDimensional Real E; Omega : Opens E; T : Distribution Omega Real top; Prop in universe 0
conclusion: compl (Distribution.dsupport T) = sUnion {U | Distribution.IsVanishingOn T U and IsOpen U}

encoding_decisions.distribution: real-valued, infinite-order mathlib Distribution on Omega
encoding_decisions.ambient_domain: an arbitrary finite-dimensional real normed space with Omega represented by Opens E
encoding_decisions.support: Distribution.dsupport, a subset of the ambient E
encoding_decisions.vanishing: Distribution.IsVanishingOn; ExpandedTarget unfolds this to evaluation on all test functions with tsupport contained in U
encoding_decisions.localization: largest-open-zero-region characterization expressed as equality with an indexed union

elaborated_not_accepted_as_equivalent: replace open zero regions by closed zero regions
equate support rather than its complement to the union
replace the union of every open zero region by existence of one such region

degenerate_cases: The quantification includes the zero distribution, empty Omega, and zero-dimensional E. No nonzero, nonempty, connectedness, or positive-dimension hypothesis is introduced.
status_boundary: Exact target elaboration and definitional test-function expansion only. No proof credit, primary-source H0 claim, downstream validation, or theorem completion is asserted.
